sum.a: {carriers} at the lowest total cost, on {sourcing} boxes.
sum.b: {carriers}: the shortest transit on carrier-owned boxes.
sum.c: {mix} on {carriers}, sized to the cargo for the best cost per transit day.
pit.transship: {carrier} transships on this lane, which adds roll-over risk.
pit.leased: Leased boxes are often older units; check the CSC plate before stuffing.
pit.free_dest: Only {days} free days at destination; book the haulier before arrival.
pit.split: Split across {n} carriers: separate bookings and bills of lading, and the cargo can arrive split.
pit.reefer: Reefer cargo: book plugs at both terminals and run a PTI before loading.
pit.hazmat: Dangerous goods: carrier DG acceptance and the IMDG declaration are needed before booking.
pit.low_fill: Boxes are only {pct} full; you are paying to ship empty space.
pit.heavy: Cargo is close to the boxes' payload limit; check road weight limits at both ends.
pit.late: Misses the deadline by about {days} days, counting {lead} days to book and gate in.
pit.tight: Only {days} days of slack before the deadline.
pit.free_time: Free time is {origin} days at origin and {dest} at destination; detention and demurrage apply after that.
as.example_rates: Rates are example tariffs until live carrier and Container xChange quotes are connected.
as.no_price: No client price in the request, so margins use a suggested quote of {amount_usd}.
as.currency: The client price was converted from {from} to USD at {rate}.
as.volume_estimated: No volume given; estimated {volume} m³ from the weight.
as.weight_estimated: No weight given; estimated {weight} kg from the volume.
as.boxes_requested: The client asked for specific containers, so every option uses them.
as.no_deadline: No deadline in the request, so deadline risk assumes no hard date.
rec.best: Option {id} keeps the best margin ({pct}) among the options that meet the deadline, with {days} days in transit.
rec.fastest: No option meets the deadline comfortably; Option {id} is the fastest.
